summary: Spire Inc. and units Spire Missouri, Spire Alabama, and Spire Tennessee filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Extension and Second Amendment to their Second Amended and Restated Loan Agreement with Wells Fargo as administrative agent. The amendment extends the final maturity one year, from October 11, 2030 to October 11, 2031; all other material terms are unchanged. No price, stake, premium, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine credit-facility amendment under Items 1.01 and 2.03, not a special situation; there is no risk-arb angle.
